title: Gortex MCP write tools can escape indexed repository roots
summary: Absolute paths and missing symlink checks let write_file, edit_file and move_inline write outside indexed repositories. Planting executable configuration can lead to later code execution.

severity.rationale: Agent tool arguments can overwrite executable configuration outside the promised repository boundary. Execution follows when that configuration is used.

exposure: An attacker must influence a write-capable MCP tool call. File access remains limited by the daemon account permissions.

params.instructions: Check github.com/zzet/gortex version and whether the documented exposure conditions apply.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed component uses the patched release and test the affected workflow with harmless inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
